analyze_email_address.description: Learn about an email address without sending it anything: its parts, who handles its mail, its MX, SPF and DMARC records, when its domain was registered, whether it is a free, disposable, forwarding or role address, whether it has a Gravatar, and a fix for a mistyped domain like gmial.com. It cannot tell whether the mailbox exists.

search_countries.description: Find every country with the text anywhere in it, ignoring case: in any field, or only in names, codes, capitals, demonyms, languages, currencies, flag descriptions or government types. Results come alphabetically, a page at a time.

descriptions.long: Canada is a Commonwealth realm with Ottawa as its capital and English and French as official languages. The Canadian dollar is the currency, and energy, minerals, forestry, manufacturing and services support a mostly southern population.
descriptions.short: Canada is a federal parliamentary state in northern North America, second in the world by area.

flag.description: The flag of Canada is composed of a red vertical band on the hoist and fly sides and a central white square that is twice the width of the vertical bands. A large eleven-pointed red maple leaf is centered in the white square.

search_countries.name: search_countries

parameters.description: The text to look for, or part of it, like 'land' or 'ger'.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Where to look for the text. Everything, if not chosen.
parameters.name: search_in

parameters.description: How many countries to return at most: up to 100 on the free plan, and 500 on paid plans.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many matching countries to skip, to get a later page. Each result gives the offset of the page after it.

description: Look up any of 250+ countries and territories by code or name, then search and list them by region, group, currency or language, with names, capitals, codes, currencies, calling codes and flags. The same REST Countries key also locates IP addresses, identifies browsers and bots from user agents, analyzes email addresses and converts currencies.
